predictions.coreRecommendation: Montserrat or Draw under 2.5 goals represents the most grounded first-leg projection given Nicaragua's three confirmed defensive injuries and two-legged tactical caution on neutral ground.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Montserrat's League C cohesion tests Nicaragua's injury-hit defense on neutral ground.

spf.comment: Covering both the 1:0 win and 1:1 stalemate respects Montserrat's 39.4% Poisson edge against an injury-hit defense while guarding against Lyle Taylor's fitness doubt and first-leg caution, making a single result call riskier.

over_under.comment: A 2.25 combined lambda, 60.9% Poisson under-2.5 share, and two-legged opening restraint point toward a controlled one- or two-goal contest.

score.comment: The top two Poisson scorelines (13.3% and 12.6%) reflect Montserrat breaking through an improvised Nicaraguan backline while either conceding once to League A attackers or preserving a clean sheet.

goals.comment: Two goals (26.7%) and one goal (23.7%) dominate the exact-total distribution in a cautious neutral-venue opener.

bqc.comment: Early two-legged discipline favors a level first half before second-half fatigue and bench adjustments decide between a narrow Montserrat win or a shared draw.
